Stream Radarv1.0.0

Stream Radar settings

Everything is stored locally in your browser. No account, no tracking.

Interface

Detection

Turning detection off here is different from "Disable on this site" in the popup: the master switch also stops the network observer.

Detection layers

Five independent layers. Keep all of them on for maximum coverage; turn them off only if a site misbehaves.

LayerWhat it hooksNeedsOn
1. Networkfetch, XMLHttpRequest.open/send, WebSocket, EventSource + browser-level webRequest (all frames, service workers, nested iframes)host permission <all_urls>
2. DOMMutationObserver + 2 s poll over video / source / iframe / embed / object / link[preload] / a[download], recursive same-origin iframe walknone
3. MSEMediaSource.addSourceBuffer, SourceBuffer.appendBuffer, URL.createObjectURL, HTMLMediaElement.src, EME/requestMediaKeySystemAccessMAIN-world script
4. Service workercaches.keys()/match() scan for video responses, service-worker registration probesame-origin page
5. Heuristicsinline-script regex, document.write, performance.getEntriesByType('resource'), JWPlayer / Video.js / Plyr / HLS.js / DASH.js internals, window config objectsnone

Subtitles & API keys

Two of the three providers need a free key. Stream Radar never uploads your watch history. The key is only sent to that provider.

Live updates

Perbaikan aturan deteksi bisa turun dari GitHub tanpa kamu perlu melepas atau install ulang extension. Payload hanya data (host, ekstensi, kata sampah), ditandatangani ECDSA, dan hanya menambah aturan bawaan.

… 

        

        

          
Kenapa ini aman

          
    
            
  • Public key ditanam di extension; pack tanpa tanda tangan yang valid ditolak mentah-mentah.
    • 
            
  • Rule pack hanya menambah (additive). Tidak bisa menghapus aturan bawaan, jadi pack basi tidak membuat buta.
    • 
            
  • Code patch mati secara default, dan tetap butuh tanda tangan yang sama.
    • 
            
  • Semua bisa dimatikan dengan satu checkbox di atas.
    •

Help

        

          
First-time setup (2 minutes)

          
    
            
  1. Firefox desktop / Chrome: load dist/firefox (or dist/chrome) as a temporary / unpacked extension. See docs/INSTALL.md.
    2. 
            
  2. Optional but recommended: paste a free SubDL API key in Subtitles & API keys. That alone enables automatic Indonesian subtitles.
    3. 
            
  3. Open a video site, press play, then click the ◉ button at the bottom-right (or Alt+Shift+S).
    4. 
            
  4. Click Watch Party on a stream: watchparty.me opens with your title as the room name and the stream as the media.
    5. 
          

          
Why is a stream still missing?

          
    
            
  • DRM (Widevine/FairPlay/PlayReady): the manifest is not downloadable. Stream Radar labels it "DRM protected" instead of failing silently.
    • 
            
  • blob: + MSE - the "URL" is a media pipeline, not a file. Use "Record buffer (beta)" after enabling it in Detection layers.
    • 
            
  • P2P players (WebTorrent, custom WASM) - segments never cross HTTP, so nothing is captured.
    • 
            
  • Strict CSP + browser without world:MAIN - Layer 1 page hooks may be blocked; LAYERS 1b/2/4/5 still work because the network observer runs outside the page.
    • 
            
  • The site is on the per-site opt-out list, or the master switch is off.
    • 
          

          
Shortcuts

          
Alt+Shift+S panel, Alt+Shift+D re-scan, Alt+Shift+F search subtitles, Esc close panel

          
Privacy

          
Stream Radar runs entirely on your machine. It makes requests only to: the page you are on (network observer, read-only), the subtitle providers you enable, and watchparty.me when you click Watch Party. No analytics, no server of ours.
